title: Final: your first scene
sub: From an empty canvas to a spinning cube
cards/0/task: Build a spinning cube from scratch.
cards/1/q: After which line did someone forget to add the canvas to the page?
cards/1/explain: The renderer.domElement canvas never got onto the page: document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement).
cards/2/q: Why might the screen be empty? Select all that apply.
cards/2/options/0: The Mesh was not added to the scene
cards/2/options/1: The camera is inside the object
cards/2/options/3: The camera was moved back along +Z
cards/2/explain: Moving the camera back along +Z is exactly the right thing to do.
cards/3/options/0: Rotates 1.5 radians per second at any frame rate
cards/3/explain: Radians, not degrees. A full turn is 2π ≈ 6.28.
cards/5/pairs/1/1: A friendly library on top of it
cards/6/explain: Without render inside the loop, the scene would change but no frames would be drawn.
cards/7/options/0: One frame: the scene as seen by this camera
cards/7/explain: For animation, call render every frame.
